child_list.content: My favorite sport
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
I like many sports, but I like basketball the most. I started playing basketball when I was in primary school. My father is a big basketball fan, and he often watches basketball games on TV. When I was a kid,

he would take me to the basketball court and teach me how to play. Playing basketball is not only fun, but also good for my health. I love everything about basketball!

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

child_list.content: 我最喜欢的运动
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 我喜欢很多运动，但我最喜欢篮球。我在小学的时候就开始打篮球了。我爸爸是一个超级篮球迷，他经常在电视上看篮球比赛。当我还是个孩子的时候，他会带我去篮球场，教我怎么打。打篮球不仅有趣，而且对我的健康也有好处。我爱篮球的一切！

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
